overview: 127 official Qs (2008, 2012, 2017, 2019, 2025) – the heaviest economy section. Growth vs development theory (31) and planning (27) lead, then national-income concepts (17) and measurement (15). Mostly one-liners (64 + 40 without printed options), 15 negative 'not' items, 5 assertion-reason, 2 statement-based. Facts asked: formula gaps (GDP/GNP/NNP, MP/FC), plan-wise slogan/model/target, committee and commission chairs, dated shares and rates.

possibility.angle: National income concepts – GDP/GNP/NNP, MP vs FC, deflator, transfer payments, circular flow
possibility.what_they_ask: which item separates two aggregates (NFIA, depreciation, net indirect taxes); what is excluded (transfers); deflator ratio direction; leakage vs injection

possibility.angle: Measurement of national income – methods, history of estimates, base year, statistical tools, state GSDP/per capita
possibility.what_they_ask: which method India uses / which is not a method; first estimator (Naoroji vs VKRV Rao); CSO base year 2011-12; top state by GSDP vs per capita; SD/variance basics

possibility.angle: Occupational pattern and sectoral distribution – workforce shares, sector shares of GDP, unemployment surveys
possibility.what_they_ask: dated % of workers in agriculture/services, sector of mining, PLFS unemployment rate, which survey measures unemployment, type of unemployment in agriculture, NCEUS chair

possibility.angle: Economic growth vs development – theories, indicators, poverty and inequality measures, growth-rate data
possibility.what_they_ask: theory–economist pairs (Rostow, Nurkse, Rosenstein-Rodan, Hirschman), 'new view' of development, poverty method (URP/MRP), NSSO inequality indicator, highest-growth period, Survey A-R statements

possibility.angle: Strategy of planning – plan models, objectives, slogans, targets, NDC/Planning Commission
possibility.what_they_ask: which plan had which model/slogan/priority/start date, target vs achievement, NDC year, Planning Commission chair, Janata rolling plan, pre-independence plans

possibility.angle: New Economic Reforms 1991 – LPG measures, BoP crisis, post-reform shifts
possibility.what_they_ask: which measure was NOT part of 1991/LPG (demonetisation, capital account convertibility), features of the 1991 crisis, year of reform, sectors opened to private firms

possibility.angle: Decentralisation of financial resources – Finance Commissions, Gadgil formula, local-body grants
possibility.evidence: 8 Qs: 2008, 2017×4, 2019×3; plus many related State FC / 14th FC panchayat Qs in other APPSC exams
possibility.what_they_ask: FC chair by number, 14th FC devolution and grant ratios (GP 90:10) and amounts, largest state share, who allocates central funds now, Gadgil formula meaning

possibility.angle: NITI Aayog – nature, thrust, roles, office-bearers, MPI
possibility.what_they_ask: what NITI does NOT do (fund allocation), cooperative federalism, bottom-up planning, Vice-Chairman, non-constitutional status, who estimates National MPI

traps.trap: [Formula] Swaps the item that separates two national aggregates
traps.spot: Options list net exports, depreciation, indirect taxes, subsidies, NFIA side by side
traps.fix: National–domestic = NFIA; gross–net = depreciation; MP–FC = indirect taxes – subsidies
traps.pyq: 'GNP is greater than GDP if…' → net foreign income positive, not exports > imports [group2-2008-paper3#121]; MP over FC by 'Indirect taxes – Subsidies' [group2-2008-paper3#26]

traps.trap: [Formula] Ratio or direction reversal in a formula
traps.spot: Deflator/real-income questions with 'real to nominal' or a product with the index
traps.pyq: Deflator option 'Real GDP to Nominal GDP' is wrong → current to constant prices [mains-2025-paper2#35]; Rs 20000 cr at index 250 → Rs 8000 [mains-2019-paper3#47]

traps.trap: [Plans] Plan-number displacement – correct feature placed in the neighbouring plan
traps.spot: Options are consecutive plan numbers or dates
traps.fix: Memorise the plan chain: 1st agri/Harrod-Domar, 2nd heavy industry/Mahalanobis, 5th Garibi Hatao, 8th from 1 Apr 1992, 11th 9%, 12th 'sustainable'
traps.pyq: 'Garibi Hatao' → 5th Plan, not 4th [prelims-2017#108]; Eighth Plan began April 1, 1992 [group2-2008-paper3#8]

traps.trap: [Names] Person–idea substitution among economists and committee chairs
traps.spot: Four names, all real economists or chairs
traps.fix: Tie each name to one idea/body (Raj Krishna–Hindu rate; Rostow–stages; Arjun Sengupta–NCEUS; Y.V. Reddy–14th FC)
traps.pyq: 'Hindu rate of growth' → Raj Krishna, stagnant growth [mains-2017-paper1#109]; stages of growth → Rostow, not Kuznets/Clark [group2-2008-paper3#38]

traps.spot: A negative question on an older plan or 1991 lists one later or earlier policy
traps.fix: Date every option; the one outside the period is the answer
traps.pyq: Gandhian 1978-79 strategy does not highlight 'Special Economic Zones' (SEZ policy 2000) [mains-2017-paper3#46]; 1991 reform did not include 'Demonetisation' [prelims-2017#103]

traps.trap: [Bodies] Function of the old body given to the new one (Planning Commission → NITI)
traps.spot: NITI options include allocation of resources/funds
traps.fix: NITI is a think tank (cooperative federalism); funds go via Finance Commission and Finance Ministry
traps.pyq: NITI does not envisage 'allocation of resources for needy states' [mains-2017-paper3#26]; central funds now allocated by Union Finance Ministry [mains-2019-paper3#12]

traps.trap: [Numbers] Level swap – national figure given for state, census vs NSS, total vs main workers
traps.spot: Two plausible numbers that both exist (27 and 13; 48.9 and 54.6)
traps.fix: Read the level and the source in the stem before matching the number
traps.pyq: 11th Plan: 27 national targets but 13 for a state like AP [group2-2008-paper3#99]; services share of workers 2011-12 was ~26.8%, not 36.7% [mains-2017-paper3#43]

traps.trap: [Concepts] Sister-concept swap (growth vs development, leakage vs injection, mixed economy vs joint sector)
traps.fix: Development = growth + structural/institutional change + welfare; saving is a leakage, investment the injection; mixed economy is economy-wide, joint sector a co-owned firm
traps.pyq: New view of development does not emphasise 'simple growth rate only' [mains-2017-paper3#29]; savings = a leakage [group2-2008-paper3#65]

techniques.name: [Formula] Write the identity chain first
techniques.how: Jot GDPmp → (+NFIA) GNPmp → (–dep) NNPmp → (–IT+S) NNPfc = NI. Then match the gap asked to one arrow.
techniques.example: 'When we refer to national income, the measure is' → end of chain = NNP at factor cost; GDPmp, NDPfc, GNPmp fall [mains-2017-paper3#23]

techniques.name: [Plans] Plan-chain anchor
techniques.how: Build the 1st–12th plan ladder (years, model, slogan, target). Locate the stem's clue on the ladder; adjacent plan numbers drop.
techniques.example: 'Heavy industry led development' → Mahalanobis → Second; Fifth/Fourth/Sixth fall [prelims-2017#96]; highest agri share of outlay → First Plan [mains-2017-paper3#56]

techniques.name: [NOT-items] Date-each-option in NOT questions
techniques.how: Put a year against every option; in a 'not part of 1991/LPG/old plan' item the odd date or never-adopted policy is the answer.
techniques.example: LPG not included: FDI defence, FDI retail, disinvestment all happened; full capital account convertibility never adopted → answer [prelims-2017#104]

techniques.name: [Theory] Cause vs symptom test
techniques.how: In 'main cause' questions ask which option produces the others; low income and idle resources are outcomes of capital shortage in the vicious circle.
techniques.example: Most important cause of underdevelopment → 'Lack of capital'; low per capita income is an effect [group2-2008-paper3#53]

techniques.name: [Bodies] Old body vs new body checklist
techniques.how: For Planning Commission/NITI/FC items test 'allocates money?', 'constitutional?', 'top-down or bottom-up?'.
techniques.example: NITI thrust → cooperative federalism; 'correct failures', 'inclusive growth', 'advise states' are side roles [mains-2017-paper3#53]

techniques.name: [Numbers] Source-and-vintage lock for numbers
techniques.how: Before picking a %, identify source (Census/NSS/PLFS/CSO) and year; pick the figure of that vintage, not the latest you know.

confusions.remember: NFIA separates GNP from GDP; net exports sit inside GDP (expenditure side)
Naoroji first estimate; Rao first scientific estimate
Big push = massive investment in industry; Nurkse = Say's law across sectors; Hirschman = leading sectors
Rostow stages (take-off); Kuznets inverted-U & NI; Clark sector shift
Heavy industry first vs wage goods vs village industries top priority
XI faster & more inclusive (9%); XII adds 'sustainable' (target 8%)
Janata rolling plan dropped, revived Panchayati Raj; 1980-85 official
Gadgil = plan assistance by Planning Commission; FC = tax share
PC 1950 allocated plan funds, top-down; NITI 1 Jan 2015 think tank, bottom-up; both executive resolutions, PM chairs
Maharashtra largest GSDP; Goa (and Sikkim) top per capita
PLFS measures unemployment rate; QES counts jobs in selected sectors
Two quarters = technical recession; double-dip = W (recession–brief recovery–recession)

anchors: NI = NNP at factor cost; GDP + NFIA = GNP
Planning Commission March 1950 (executive resolution); NDC 6 Aug 1952; NITI Aayog 1 Jan 2015
Plan holidays 1966-69 and 1990-92; Eighth Plan 1 Apr 1992–1997; Twelfth Plan ended 2017
First Plan target 2.1% achieved 3.6%; XI Plan target 9%; XII Plan 8% (approach paper 9%)
5th Plan = Garibi Hatao; 2nd = Mahalanobis heavy industry; 1st = highest agriculture outlay share
14th FC (Y.V. Reddy): 42% devolution; GP grants basic:performance 90:10; GP total ₹2,00,292.20 cr; UP largest share
FC chairs: 11th Khusro, 12th Rangarajan, 13th Kelkar, 14th Y.V. Reddy, 15th N.K. Singh
NITI VCs: Panagariya, Rajiv Kumar (2017-22), Suman Bery; NITI estimates National MPI
1991: devaluation July 1991, gold pledged, LERMS 1992; demonetisation was 1978 and 2016
Poverty: Lakdawala URP, Tendulkar MRP, Rangarajan MMRP; NSSO inequality via consumption (MPCE)
checklist: Formula item? Write the GDP→NI chain and find the one arrow asked.
Plan item? Place the clue (model, slogan, target, year) on the 1st–12th ladder.
'NOT' item? Put a date or 'adopted?' against every option – the misfit wins.
Number item? Fix source (Census/NSS/PLFS/CSO), level (India/state, main/total) and year first.
Name item? Recall one idea per economist/chair; reject real names attached to the wrong idea.
NITI/FC/PC item? Ask who allocates money and whether it is constitutional.
